utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—what’s the plan for the next book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m thinking we keep it simple this time—same place, bring snacks, and we can pick the next book together.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Book club, right? I’m in—just send me the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — I’ll send the time and place as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks — I’ll keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, the book club meeting is still on for Thursday, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I’d want to double-check the time and place before we count on it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, let’s confirm it before we show up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the book club! I’m glad you brought it up, because I was just thinking I should probably remember which book we picked.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I think we picked the mystery one for next Tuesday. I’ll grab my notes and double-check so we don’t mix it up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — I’d appreciate that. I’d hate to show up with the wrong book again.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Noah — before I say yes, could you remind me which book the club picked and when we’re meeting?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I’m blanking on the exact pick and meeting time. Let me check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No worries — just send me the book and time when you confirm, and I’ll let you know if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I’m late—what book club pick are we on?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — we’re on "The Midnight Library." Want me to catch you up on where we left off?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yes please — I’d love a quick catch-up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing—what’s the book club reading this week?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I haven’t heard the title yet—want to tell me what it is?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m happy to help—where and when is the book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — let’s meet at the library on Thursday at 6 PM.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — the library on Thursday at 6 PM.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the book club’s picking a new read soon—have you heard any of the suggestions yet?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Not yet, but I’ve got a feeling it’s going to be a good one. If you want, I can let you know as soon as I hear the list!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, please do—I’d love to know. I’m already curious what everyone’s leaning toward!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, are we meeting at the library this week, or did that change?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure yet — I should check with everyone. I’ll let you know once I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, just let me know when you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll tell the others we’re meeting about the book club.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate you passing that along. I’ll wait to hear what everyone decides.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’ve got the book club notes ready, and I’m happy to help set things up. What are you thinking for the next meeting?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’m thinking we keep it simple this time — maybe pick one short book and meet at my place if that works.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds perfect, Uli — simple is good. Pick a short book, and I’ll help coordinate the details for your place.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, book club? I haven’t heard the latest yet, but I can keep an ear out and tell you when I do.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That would be much appreciated, Tess. I like to know the plan ahead of time, so just let me know when you hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything about the plan.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I might be running a bit late, but I’d still love to join the book club. What book are you all discussing?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — we’re discussing "The Midnight Library" tonight, and I’ll repeat the plan if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — that sounds great. I’ll catch up with the plan when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m thinking I might stop by the book club and just listen this time. What’s the group reading?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: We’re reading a short mystery this month. You’re welcome to just listen—no pressure.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds perfect. I’ll come by and mostly listen, then—thanks for the invite.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, book club—nice. What book are we on?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We’re on “The Lantern House” this month. We meet at the community center on Thursday evening.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—Thursday evening at the community center. I’ll try to make it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’d love to help bridge the book club groups—what are you all reading right now?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: We’re reading "The River Between Us" this month, but I should double-check the exact edition before I say more.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Nice, thanks for checking — I can wait on the edition. Once you know it, I’ll help keep everyone on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the book club. I probably missed the latest update; what did I forget?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: You were going to bring a copy of the next book and let us know if you’re coming on Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks for the reminder—I’ll bring the copy and I’m probably coming Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I haven’t heard any book club updates yet—did something change?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thursday sounds great, Uli — thanks for being flexible. I’ll pencil you in and send the details soon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, Thursday works for me too. Just send the details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d love that, thanks! Text me when you know, and I’ll try to make it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll text you once I know the time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, thanks Leo! Looking forward to it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’ll need the time and place nailed down first so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I’m thinking Thursday at 7 at the community center. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That should work for me, as long as the community center room is booked and we’re not running too late.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, you should come to book club this week — I think you’d really like the group. I’ll send you the details!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, that sounds lovely — I’d be happy to come. Please send me the details when you can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the time and address right now. We’d love to have you there!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can make book club work as long as it doesn’t bump into school pickup. What time are we thinking?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — we should keep it after school pickup. How about 4:30?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sorry I’m late — did I miss the carpool plan?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell — I’m glad we’re finally talking book club. What are you thinking for this month’s read?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve been hearing good things about a few picks, but I’m still catching up. If you have a favorite in mind, I’m happy to go with that.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’d love to keep it easy this month—how about a warm, engaging novel everyone can get into? If you want, I can bring a couple of options and we can pick together.
